title: Stepwise-Querying: Distilling Reasoning without Access to Teacher Chain-of-Thought
summary: Stepwise Querying ranks first in 14 of 16 student/teacher/benchmark comparisons; the GSM8K diagnostic indicates valid intermediate reasoning can remain useful in trajectories with wrong final answers. Scope is the reported models and benchmarks. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
